Jetakarṇa
Brahman Pandit of Yambu in Nepal. Joint translator into Tibetan of Cāndravyākaraṇa an. Vim3śatyupasargavṛtti of Candragomin an. the Varṇasūtravṛtti of Dharmapāla. See JASB. 1907, p.. 122, 123.

Jetāri
or Jitāripāda of Vārendra. son of Garbhapāda. C. 1000 A. D. See above, p. 248b; also NIA. I. p. 9; ABORI. XI. p.. 54-8.
